pair.qualification: Normalized checked observables agree, including a shared disabled-placeholder deviation. Native graph hierarchy/names and outer frame bounds differ; exact file equality is not required.

definitions_open_or_conflicting.finding: Font weight/style, exact glyph baseline/input vertical centering and font file/version are not explicitly fixed. Do not invent exact baselines or pixel-identical glyph rasterization.
Height/content mandated; precise text inset/color beyond inherited component styles not explicitly specified as option. Report variations without inventing option styling.

No scrollbar appearance/width specified. Default ready/active scroll offset not numerically fixed; normal document flow starts at top, but only scroll-end explicit reveal is a hard endpoint constraint.

No OpenPencil metadata schema, exact node type, key-name syntax, component-instance type, or complete hidden-popup retained structure mandated. Must remain understandable/editable and preserve result identities.
Explicit token20 applies to status even at font12. Empty status has empty text; native lack of drawable empty text node may be represented by named group/part.
Viewport overflow clipping mandated; popup radius8 mandated. Definition does not explicitly require overflow hidden on surface or a particular clipping shape.

README says three invisible data items; stories specify seven results, viewport160/row32 yields five visible and two outside. Both artifacts preserve seven and apply numeric rules. This inconsistency was noticed in comparison phase and does not amend preregistration.

disabled_placeholder_adjudication.reason: Explicit ::placeholder color muted applies to placeholder pseudo-element; :disabled color on input supplies inherited color and does not override explicitly specified pseudo-element color. Preregistered ambiguity decision already stated placeholder stays muted under ordinary CSS. Reports describe missing priority, but that does not remove the explicit CSS requirement.
disabled_placeholder_adjudication.scope: Single static visual difference; no behavior failure inferred.
